24bb6d01f2508e4001990348616aff2cadc34cd1.summary: Overview by Sekoia and Kudelski Security of North Korea's (DPRK) cyber organisation. It covers the state bodies with offensive cyber mandates (GRIB, formerly RGB; NIA, formerly MSS; the KWP), DPRK-nexus clusters tracked as APTs (including Lazarus sub-clusters, Kimsuky, Andariel, Moonstone Sleet, Reaper), the fake IT worker programme, and revenue from cryptocurrency theft and laundering, including through Cambodia. The report stresses frequent reorganisation and differing vendor naming.

243c3c5089789e3b641c19f5ff997c631beacc9f.summary: The report analyses a Linux crypto-miner ELF binary (file named 41hs1z) and identifies it as a component of the Sysrv botnet. The loader script was presumably run after exploiting a web application vulnerability. The Go binary sets up cron persistence, checks a local port to avoid re-infecting the host, enumerates private SSH keys to spread, and carries a WordPress exploit and hardcoded brute-force credential lists.
